lines.en: What will we do on Sunday?
I want to go to the park. Do you agree?
I agree. But it rained last Sunday.
lines.ko: 동의해요. 그런데 지난 일요일에는 비가 왔어요.

lines.en: Let's decide on Saturday. We will check the weather.
lines.ko: 그럼 토요일에 정해요. 날씨를 확인할 거예요.

lines.en: Good. Can we avoid the busy road this time?
lines.ko: 좋아요. 이번에는 복잡한 길을 피할 수 있을까요?

lines.en: Sure. I will choose a quiet way.
And I will prepare lunch for us.
Great. Let's change our shoes and walk more.
lines.ko: 좋아요. 신발을 바꿔 신고 더 걸어요.

lines.en: Okay. Did you solve the car problem yesterday?
Yes, I did. The car is fine now.
Hello. What would you like today?
I can't decide. What do you have today?
lines.ko: 결정을 못 하겠어요. 오늘은 뭐가 있어요?

lines.en: The fish soup is good. Many people choose it.
I ate fish yesterday. Is the chicken good?
Yes. Do you want rice or noodles with it?
Rice, please. I try to avoid too much salt.
lines.ko: 밥으로 주세요. 소금을 너무 많이 먹지 않으려고 해요.

lines.en: Okay. We will bring it in ten minutes.
Thank you. May I have some warm tea too?
Yes. The tea is free. Please sit here.
Thank you. I plan to come again.
